- 111 frames: 3 wrong slots checked (or 2 correct + 1 wrong)

- 66 = 2 slots × ~33 frames each
- 111 = 3 slots × ~37 frames each

- 42 frames = stops at slot 1 (wrong)
- 66 frames = stops at slot 2 (wrong)
- 111 frames = stops at slot 3 (wrong)
So with O, p, R / b, N, Y, M (111 frames), slots 1 and 2 were correct (O, p), but slot 3 was wrong (R).
With O, R, Y / b, N, p, M (66 frames), slot 1 was correct (O), but slot 2 was wrong (R).

Now I need to figure out what's correct for slot 3. With O, p, R giving 111 frames, slot 3 (R) was wrong.
Let me try O, p, Y to see if that gives more frames.
